myEscrows.title: My Escrows
myEscrows.subtitle: Track secured auction funds held in escrow between buyer and seller throughout the 7-day inspection window.

banner.title: How does Mazadak Escrow Protection work?
banner.body: Winning auction amounts are securely held upon completion. The buyer has 7 days to inspect the item, after which funds auto-release to the seller unless a dispute is opened.
banner.point3: Direct dispute resolution if issues arise

empty.title: No escrow transactions found
empty.descAll: When you win an auction or complete a sale, all escrow-protected transactions will appear here.
empty.descFilter: No transactions match the selected filter.

myEscrows.errorMessage: Please check your internet connection and try again.

detail.buyerSubtitle: You are the buyer in this transaction. Your funds are secured in escrow until you inspect and accept the delivered item.
detail.sellerSubtitle: You are the seller in this transaction. Funds are guaranteed and will release to your wallet once buyer confirms delivery or upon inspection expiry.
detail.generalSubtitle: Detailed audit log and status of secured escrow intermediation.
detail.disputeActiveDesc: Transaction is under investigation by Mazadak dispute committee to reach a binding settlement.
detail.actionsDesc: If you have received and inspected the item, confirm delivery to release funds, or open a dispute if issues were encountered.
detail.guarantee1: Encrypted vault holding: Funds are never paid out until inspection passes.
detail.guarantee2: Full 7-day statutory inspection window to verify item authenticity.
detail.guarantee3: Dedicated dispute arbitration committee protecting both buyers and sellers.
detail.notFoundDesc: Could not locate this escrow transaction, or you may lack permission to view it.
detail.confirmDeliverySuccess: Delivery confirmed and funds successfully released to seller

openDispute.subtitle: If you encounter any issues with item delivery or condition, you may open a formal dispute before inspection window ends to freeze funds for committee review.
openDispute.descriptionPlaceholder: Please provide a clear and comprehensive explanation of the issue encountered (at least 10 characters)...
openDispute.uploadDropzonePrompt: Click to upload evidence photos or drag and drop
openDispute.uploadHint: JPG, PNG, WebP up to 10MB each (maximum 5 photos)
openDispute.invalidFormatError: Unsupported file format (only JPG, PNG, WebP)
openDispute.uploadFailed: Failed to upload images, please retry
openDispute.whatHappensNextTitle: What happens after opening a dispute?
openDispute.step1Desc: Automatic fund release is immediately paused, securing the full winning bid amount in escrow.
openDispute.step2Desc: A specialized dispute officer reviews all documentation, item description, and evidence photos.
openDispute.step3Desc: A fair resolution is issued to either refund the buyer in full or pay the seller within 24-48 hours.
openDispute.submitSuccess: Dispute opened successfully and forwarded to arbitration committee
openDispute.notBuyerError: Only the designated buyer is eligible to open a dispute on this transaction.
openDispute.notHeldError: Cannot open a dispute because escrow status is not active (HELD).
openDispute.expiredWindowError: The 7-day inspection window has expired. Funds are scheduled for automatic release.

validation.descriptionRequired: Please provide a description of the issue

inspection.title: Remaining Inspection & Verification Window
inspection.windowSubtitle: You have a full inspection window of {{days}} days before automatic release
inspection.instruction: You may inspect and verify the item during this window, then click "Confirm Delivery" to release payment or open a dispute if any discrepancy exists.
inspection.expiredDesc: The 7-day inspection window has passed. The system will automatically release funds to the seller.

confirmModal.title: Confirm Item Delivery & Release Payment
confirmModal.amountToRelease: Amount to be released to seller:
confirmModal.warningTitle: Warning: This action is final and irreversible
confirmModal.warningText: By confirming, you acknowledge that you have inspected and received the item in satisfactory condition matching all descriptions. Funds will be transferred immediately to the seller's wallet and you will not be able to dispute or reverse this transaction.

counterparty.verifiedNotice: All participants in the escrow protection system are identity-verified and bound by platform terms.

disputeDetail.subtitle: Official arbitration dispute file undergoing review and resolution by the committee.
disputeDetail.arbitrationFileSubtitle: Transaction currently under arbitration committee review
disputeDetail.cancelDisputeDesc: As the claimant, you can cancel this dispute at any time to resume normal escrow release.
disputeDetail.notFoundDesc: Could not locate this dispute record or you lack permission to view it.
disputeDetail.noEvidenceProvided: No evidence photos were attached to this dispute.
disputeDetail.refundBuyerExplanation: Based on evidence and transaction review, the arbitration committee ruled in favor of a full refund to the buyer.
disputeDetail.paySellerExplanation: Based on evidence and auction review, the committee ruled the item conforms to specs and released payment to the seller.

cancelDisputeModal.title: Cancel Financial Dispute
cancelDisputeModal.confirmQuestion: Are you sure you want to cancel this dispute?
cancelDisputeModal.warningDesc: Upon cancellation, the escrow will immediately revert to standard HELD status.
cancelDisputeModal.point1: You will regain the ability to confirm delivery and release payment after inspection.
cancelDisputeModal.point2: The remaining inspection countdown will resume automatically.
cancelDisputeModal.point3: Funds remain safely held in escrow and are not transferred to the seller until you confirm delivery.
cancelDisputeModal.cancelSuccess: Financial dispute cancelled successfully and escrow returned to active status
